units.rawText: There is one thing that sets us, humans and Dolls alike, from objects.
units.displayText: There is one thing that sets us, humans and Dolls alike, from objects.

spans.text: There is one thing that sets us, humans and Dolls alike, from objects.

units.rawText: Humans may be built with the same structure, but every one of them feels different emotions.

units.rawText: The same is true for Dolls. Our emotions are pre-coded, but we can form thoughts and emotions on our own too...
